cloudtrail_kms_encryption_enabled.rationale: Customer-Managed KMS Keys (CMKs) cost $1.00/month per key plus API request fees, exceeding the $0.00 lab guardrail.
cloudtrail_kms_encryption_enabled.compensating_control: Audit Vault enforces default SSE-S3 (AES-256) encryption at rest, TLS-only bucket policy, Block Public Access, and CloudTrail log file integrity validation.

s3_bucket_kms_encryption.rationale: KMS CMK billing ($1.00/key/month) is excluded under zero-cost architecture.
s3_bucket_kms_encryption.compensating_control: All S3 buckets enforce AES-256 server-side encryption, HTTPS-only transport, versioning, and account-level Block Public Access.

cloudtrail_s3_dataevents_read_enabled.rationale: CloudTrail S3 Data Events incur per-100,000-event charges outside the free management-event trail.
cloudtrail_s3_dataevents_read_enabled.compensating_control: S3 Server Access Logging captures object-level access telemetry alongside free CloudTrail management event logging.

cloudtrail_s3_dataevents_write_enabled.rationale: CloudTrail S3 Data Events incur per-100,000-event charges outside the free management-event trail.
cloudtrail_s3_dataevents_write_enabled.compensating_control: S3 Versioning and Server Access Logging record object write/delete operations and protect against accidental overwrite.

config_recorder_all_regions_enabled.rationale: AWS Config charges per configuration item recorded and per rule evaluation.
config_recorder_all_regions_enabled.compensating_control: Daily scheduled Prowler CSPM scans via GitHub Actions OIDC plus Terraform state drift tracking provide continuous configuration assurance.

s3_bucket_cross_region_replication.rationale: Cross-Region Replication introduces inter-region data transfer and duplicate storage costs for non-production audit logs.
s3_bucket_cross_region_replication.compensating_control: Single-region us-east-1 S3 Standard durability (11 nines across multiple AZs) with versioning enabled.

vpc_different_regions.rationale: Project Watchtower operates exclusively in us-east-1 with no production VPC workloads requiring multi-region active-active failover.
vpc_different_regions.compensating_control: All infrastructure is codified in Terraform and can be redeployed into a secondary region on demand.

organizations_account_part_of_organizati.rationale: Standalone single-account environment; AWS Organizations multi-account landing zone is not required for scope.
organizations_account_part_of_organizati.compensating_control: Strict IAM least-privilege roles, immutable OIDC trust claims, and account-level guardrails.

organizations_tags_policies_enabled_and_.rationale: Depends on AWS Organizations; not applicable to a standalone account.
organizations_tags_policies_enabled_and_.compensating_control: Consistent resource tagging enforced via Terraform default_tags in providers.tf.

bedrock_model_invocation_logging_enabled.rationale: Amazon Bedrock is not provisioned or invoked in this AWS account.
bedrock_model_invocation_logging_enabled.compensating_control: Zero Bedrock usage verified via CloudTrail and AWS Budgets monitoring.

iam_role_access_not_stale_to_bedrock.rationale: Amazon Bedrock is unused; IAM roles do not execute Bedrock workloads.
iam_role_access_not_stale_to_bedrock.compensating_control: Prowler scanner role uses read-only AWS managed policies with no Bedrock invocation permissions.

iam_user_access_not_stale_to_bedrock.rationale: Amazon Bedrock is unused; IAM users do not invoke Bedrock APIs.
iam_user_access_not_stale_to_bedrock.compensating_control: Zero Bedrock usage monitored via CloudTrail.

iam_user_hardware_mfa_enabled.rationale: Physical FIDO2/hardware MFA tokens are not issued for this solo lab environment.
iam_user_hardware_mfa_enabled.compensating_control: Virtual TOTP Authenticator MFA enforced for console access and keyless OIDC federation used for CI/CD automation.

iam_avoid_root_usage.rationale: Initial AWS account creation and billing activation required root sign-in within the lookback window.
iam_avoid_root_usage.compensating_control: Root account is retired from daily operations; CloudWatch metric filter and alarm alert immediately on any future root usage.

iam_aws_attached_policy_no_administrativ.rationale: Local Terraform bootstrap identity requires administrative permissions to provision IAM, CloudTrail, S3, and CloudWatch controls.
iam_aws_attached_policy_no_administrativ.compensating_control: Automated GitHub Actions scanning uses strictly read-only OIDC role (SecurityAudit + ViewOnlyAccess); admin profile is local-only and never stored in CI/CD.

cloudwatch_changes_to_network_gateways_a.rationale: AWS CloudWatch Always Free tier caps custom metrics and standard alarms at 10; top 10 highest-impact CIS/ISO alarms are prioritized.
cloudwatch_changes_to_network_gateways_a.compensating_control: All gateway API events remain captured in CloudTrail and CloudWatch Logs; VPC and NACL alarms cover perimeter changes.

cloudwatch_log_metric_filter_aws_organiz.rationale: AWS Organizations is not enabled; alarm slot preserved for active-service controls within the 10-alarm free cap.
cloudwatch_log_metric_filter_aws_organiz.compensating_control: Standalone account with full CloudTrail management event recording.

cloudwatch_log_metric_filter_disable_or_.rationale: No Customer-Managed KMS Keys exist in this account; alarm slot preserved within the 10-alarm free cap.
cloudwatch_log_metric_filter_disable_or_.compensating_control: All buckets rely on AWS-managed SSE-S3 encryption; any future CMK creation is logged in CloudTrail.

cloudwatch_log_metric_filter_and_alarm_f.rationale: AWS Config is not enabled; alarm slot preserved within the 10-alarm free cap.
cloudwatch_log_metric_filter_and_alarm_f.compensating_control: CloudTrail configuration change alarm and daily Prowler scans monitor audit pipeline integrity.

cloudwatch_log_group_kms_encryption_enab.rationale: Customer-Managed KMS Keys (CMKs) cost $1.00/month plus API request fees, exceeding the zero-cost guardrail.
cloudwatch_log_group_kms_encryption_enab.compensating_control: CloudWatch Logs encrypts log group data at rest by default using AWS-managed AES-256 encryption, restricted to least-privilege IAM roles.

s3_bucket_server_access_logging_enabled.rationale: Enabling server access logging on the dedicated access-logs sink bucket itself creates an infinite recursive log-generation and billing loop.
s3_bucket_server_access_logging_enabled.compensating_control: All primary workload and audit buckets (audit-vault, tfstate) enforce S3 Server Access Logging into this hardened, TLS-only, non-public sink bucket.

backup_reportplans_exist.rationale: AWS Backup Audit Manager report plans and compliance frameworks introduce AWS Config resource tracking and evaluation fees, exceeding the $0.00/mo budget guardrail, and no production workloads are assigned to backup jobs.
backup_reportplans_exist.compensating_control: Baseline AWS Backup vault and daily retention plan are codified in Terraform; state and audit evidence are versioned in S3 and continuously verified via Prowler and GitHub Actions.
